category_counts_basis: counted from api.polyhaven.com/assets?t=models: 2 = names starting 'Modular' (15); 5 = site categories 'ships' or 'rigged' (18, e.g. Dutch ships, cannon, vice, clocks); 4 = 'creature' (1, Street Rat); 1 = remaining 487 props/nature/furniture/etc.
licence_words: All assets ( HDRIs , textures and 3D models ) on this site are the original work of Poly Haven staff, or artists who willingly and directly donate/sell their work to Poly Haven. Our assets are all licensed as CC0 , which is effectively Public Domain even in jurisdictions that do not support the Public Domain.
formats: PBR texture maps (diffuse, normal dx/gl, rough, metal, ARM) up to 4K-8K
style: photoreal PBR, mostly scanned or hand-modelled real-world objects; median ~11k tris (range 182 to 17.4M), needs decimation/texture downscale for Roblox MeshPart
human_made_evidence: polyhaven.com/faq: 'All of our assets are made by humans with love, we do not use any generative AI in the creation of our work.' Textures FAQ: made with photogrammetry/photometric stereo, 'We do not make textures procedurally, or using generative AI.' Every asset in the API lists named human authors (135 distinct model authors; published 2020-03-30 to 2026-07-03).
bulk_download: Public API (api.polyhaven.com/assets?t=<type> lists all; /files/<id> gives per-format download URLs on dl.polyhaven.org). API ToS: free incl. commercial; calls need a unique User-Agent/Referer naming the app; surfacing content via the LIVE API needs a light 'Powered by Poly Haven' credit (not required for downloaded/self-hosted CC0 files). Site ToS forbids scraping polyhaven.com pages without permission, so use the API, not page scraping.
free_tier_only_note: Everything is free; no paid tier gates any asset (Patreon only gives early access / vaults funding). Optional paid 'Bulk Snapshot' via polyhaven.com/corporate - not needed.
